name: hot-lead-founder
description: Founder DMing with specific intent. Should move toward qualified after one discovery turn, then notify Sam on Telegram before sending Calendly.

input.text: I'm a founder of a B2B SaaS, we want to add an AI feature to our product in the next 30 days. Do you do advisory work for that?

expected_features: confirms advisory is the right offer (cohort is not for this case)
asks one specific qualifying question (e.g. 'what's the feature?' or 'what's the timeline?')
does NOT send Calendly yet — qualification first
